text:
Ellen Park: FYI Nordic marketplace reviewer flagged our EdgePartner-NO joint listing. They want a localized security bundle: (1) SOC2 control summary in EN/NO, (2) pen-test executive summary + remediation ETA, (3) statement of FIPS-equivalence or algorithm mapping for local gov catalogs. cc @Arjun Rao @Vera Holm
Arjun Rao: Noted. Do we have a Norwegian translation resource for the control summary?
Vera Holm: I can handle Norwegian translation for the 1-pager. Legal: is the FIPS-equivalence ask the same as earlier FIPS requests or more of an algorithm mapping? @legal-sig
legal-sig: In Norway they usually accept a crypto-algorithm statement listing algorithms and HSM attestation. Full FIPS validation is not required for civil marketplace, but the gov-adjacent catalog asks for explicit mapping (e.g., AES-256-GCM -> vendor HSM mode). We should produce a short mapping doc and HSM attestation.
Nordic-Reviewer: For the gov-adjacent catalog we need: algorithm mapping, HSM attestation (public certs), and a short remediation timeline for any critical findings from pen testing. No PoCs please.
Ellen Park: Okay. Evidence-bot, can you pre-create a manifest skeleton with sensible TTLs? We'll keep SOC2 excerpt 14d, pen exec 14d, hsm attestation 90d, mapping doc 30d.
evidence-bot: Manifest created: items -> soc2-summary-en-no.pdf (14d), pen-exec-summary.pdf (14d), hsm-attestation.pdf (90d), crypto-mapping.pdf (30d). Manifest ID: nordic-edge-2167894321.
Arjun Rao: Ops: generate firmware hash for runtime v2.4.0 and include checksum in manifest. Use standard command and paste output in firmware.sha256.txt. Who will run? @EdgePartner-NO?
EdgePartner-NO: EdgePartner will run the hash on the device image they host and upload to our presign when ready. They prefer Redwood to provide the affidavit template.
Vera Holm: I'll draft bilingual SOC2 control summary (EN/NO). Arjun, please share the control excerpts to include (access control, change mgmt, incident response).
Arjun Rao: Sharing the excerpts in a private gdoc and will paste redacted text into the summary. Reminder: remove usernames and employee PII.
legal-sig: Drafting HSM attestation + crypto mapping template. Will include fields: HSM vendor, model, cert fingerprint, algorithm support table, and a short statement that private keys are non-exportable. Also adding an optional clause about remote attestation sessions.
Ellen Park: Timeline: reviewer wants inbound bundle in 72 hours. Owners: Vera -> SOC2 EN/NO (due 36h). Arjun -> pen exec summary + remediation CSV (due 24h). legal-sig -> HSM attestation + crypto mapping (due 24h). evidence-bot -> generate presigns when uploads complete. EdgePartner-NO -> firmware hash upload (due 48h).
Arjun Rao: Pen exec drafted, removed PII and exploit details. Added remediation ETA column with owners. Will upload shortly.
Vera Holm: Draft SOC2 summary (EN/NO) uploaded to the manifest as soc2-summary-en-no.pdf. Translation note: kept control narratives concise.
evidence-bot: Uploaded files and created presign links. Firmware hash pending. Manifest nordic-edge-2167894321 now contains uploaded items.
legal-sig: HSM attestation and crypto-mapping PDFs uploaded. Included vendor attestation from SafeVault HSM (public cert fingerprint: 7c:2a:...). Also added optional remote attestation window language.
EdgePartner-NO: Firmware hash uploaded: sha256: e7a1d3c4... (full file in manifest). We will co-sign the affidavit once you provide the template.
Ellen Park: Great. Next step: share manifest link with reviewer and include a README in Norwegian explaining redactions and contact points. Vera, can you add README-no.md?
Vera Holm: README-no.md added to manifest. It has brief redaction rationale and contact: ellen@redwood.com (primary).
Nordic-Reviewer: Received manifest. We'll review and may request a 30-minute live HSM attestation session. We'll also confirm whether the crypto mapping meets the gov-adjacent catalog. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Ellen Park: If they request live HSM attestation, route to infra-sre and schedule within 48h. Closing actions: follow up if reviewer asks for apostille or notarization (unlikely here). Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
